players.product: Sqale neutral-atom quantum computer (plus quantum clocks and RF sensors)

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion 10-Q: Q2 2026 total revenue was $13,538 thousand (Q2 2025: $5,277 thousand), up 157% - product revenue $3,173 thousand (-11%) and service revenue $10,365 thousand (+504%); gross profit $2,167 thousand; loss from operations $29,858 thousand. First-half 2026 revenue was $23,445 thousand (+74%). The 10-Q figure supersedes the lower Q2 revenue stated on the company's earnings call. Q2 cost of revenue rose mainly on a $3.3 million increase in subcontractor expense primarily related to the QGG contract.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue $13,538 thousand (+157%); service revenue $10,365 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion 10-Q: prior-period figures were revised (as reported vs as adjusted) - Q1 2026 revenue $9,461 thousand to $9,907 thousand; 2025 revenue $32,464 thousand to $31,108 thousand; 2024 revenue $28,836 thousand to $28,094 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue $9,907 thousand as adjusted; 2025 revenue $31,108 thousand as adjusted

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion 10-Q: one customer (Customer A, not named) accounted for 82% of Q2 2026 revenue (Q2 2025: 64%) and 74% of first-half 2026 revenue (H1 2025: 56%); government customers were 92% of Q2 2026 revenue (Q2 2025: 85%) and 89% of first-half revenue; revenue from U.S. customers was $12,514 thousand in Q2 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 82% of Q2 2026 revenue; government 92%

quarterly_data.signal: Partner NVIDIA: Infleqtion 10-Q - in April 2026 Infleqtion announced an integration of its Sqale neutral atom quantum computer and NVIDIA Ising models for calibration and decoding; as part of the Illinois Quantum & Microelectronics Park initiative it also established its Chicago Quantum Innovation Center.
